asr.decision: Use openai-whisper medium.en on the RTX 4090 for initial English ASR; retain source subtitles when present, and only fall back to small.en for throughput emergencies. Re-evaluate large-v3 on a 60-second sample before finalizing the production model.

diarization.decision: Use ECAPA embeddings over ASR speech regions as the first production diarization layer, with anonymous clusters until reference-based Neuro/Evil/Vedal mapping is validated. Do not treat silhouette as speaker accuracy.

known_limitations: Synthetic Neuro/Evil TTS may not match ECAPA's human-speaker training distribution.
Overlap, music, chat TTS, and laughter require explicit overlap/uncertainty labels.
The production pipeline must benchmark a pyannote/WhisperX option if public model access is available; otherwise keep this fallback documented.
